features: SEC-01: Disabled UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace in iOS Info.plist and migrated local JSON caches to ApplicationSupportDirectory with seamless fallback migration
SEC-02: Server-side session revocation (/api/method/logout), local TerritoryWebServer shutdown, in-memory cache teardown on logout, and cross-user cache isolation on user switch
SEC-03: Removed hardcoded pims@admin service account fallback password in Streamlit and desktop web portal servers

SEC-04: Zero-dependency on-device ISO/IEC 18004 QR Code encoder & CustomPainter (LocalQrCodeWidget) eliminating third-party api.qrserver.com calls, plus strict CORS and HttpOnly cookie hardening on TerritoryWebServer
SEC-05 & SEC-06: Strict RBAC guard on toggleSfeMode(), removal of unused setUserPosition(), and removal of broad email substring Admin escalation
SEC-07: Comprehensive AppLogger redaction for JSON credentials, sid cookies, and Bearer headers, with zero raw print() calls across lib/
Ultra-Smooth O(1) Directory Search Optimization in DoctorAccountScreen (_doctorsById map lookup) and pre-tokenized fast filtering in DoctorMasterlistScreen
